data.name: Oraquel
data.description: Oraquel S.A. is a Warsaw-based direct air capture developer that designs modular, solar-powered DAC reactors using patented replaceable sorbent filters. In September 2025 Oraquel signed a partnership with the city of Kielce to deploy Poland's first DAC pilot facility (~500 tCO2/year), with Oraquel covering the ~1.4 million zloty construction cost and installation targeted for end of 2025.
